summary: Verified PDF export bug fix on ticket generator. Playwright ran top-level (not iframe), so anchor-download path was exercised. Both default filename (9848.pdf) and custom filename (ticket-test.pdf) triggered valid downloads. Downloaded files start with %PDF header (verified binary). Edited value fields (field-nPesee=999999, field-poidsNet=12345) reflected in ticket and PDF exported successfully. No console errors, no page errors, success toast visible.
critical_code_review_comments: handleSave: filename sanitization regex allows unicode word chars via \w which is fine, but empty-after-clean fallback works.
URL.revokeObjectURL scheduled after 60s which is fine; consider revoking after download click in top-level path.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PDF export verified via Playwright accept_downloads default context. Default filename 9848.pdf (1918KB approx) and custom 'ticket-test' both produce valid %PDF files. No JS errors during html2canvas+jsPDF path. Bug reported by user does not reproduce in top-level context; user was likely in Emergent preview iframe where new-tab fallback is used (window.open). That path was not tested here (Playwright runs top-level).
